name: Lopsided
description: One wobbly table for up to eight. Everyone drops a stone at once; the rim scores most, but weight tips the table and whatever slides off is gone.
help: Each beat, tap the table where your next stone should land (drag to adjust). Everyone's stones drop at once. The table tips toward the weight and stones that slide off the edge are lost. When the round ends, stones on the table score: rim 3, ring 2, middle 1. Once a round you may drop your boulder (three times the weight), or keep it for 3 points. The last round counts double.
